name: ui-contour
meaning: Code-first scope: full UI ring (create, resource load, resize, update, render, input, open/close). Active chain: MAIN/ENTRY MENU. Recover original contracts and dependencies through their production consumers. Pinned CEGUI/OGRE behavior is reused with documented differences.
library_boundary: CEGUI 0.6.2 + OGRE 1.6.5 behavior from the pinned vendor/library version is reused at the boundary; changes to bundled library behavior are tracked separately. Main/credits now execute vendored upstream CEGUI v0-6-2 commit 3ed5c719c3bb27b877b192e034ef2c0b05ea722c with reviewed Runic tags and TinyXML text adapters; see research/cegui-source-integration.md. Other pages still use the bounded custom runtime.
first_packet: MAIN/ENTRY MENU: CMainMenu::createMenus 0x00c52a10, update 0x00c53b70, onClick 0x00c4ae80 and CDropdownMenu dependencies. Shared frontend WindowRuntime owns retained containers, activation, capture/modal, deferred destruction and class-specific ordered pointer consumers; research/dropdown-container-lifecycle.md and research/ui-capture-modal-lifecycle.md. CMainMenu flags=1 stays model-null. Options consumes original dropdown animation/tag projection/mesh and sound22/66; Settings overrides are nonanimated. No native modal producer is inferred from AlwaysOnTop. research/dropdown-animation-lifecycle.md records source contracts. Frontend tooltip/renderer/cache/factory teardown, Settings Combobox and repeat/double-click consumers are connected: research/cegui-frontend-closure.md. General CEGUI classes/SubscriberSlot/exception ABI, GameClient safepointers/external CGameUI, general CGenericModel and FMOD ownership remain outside this packet; original-function completion remains partial. 2026-09-30: Main/credits default resource path now uses the actual pinned source library and GLES quad adapter, without a duplicate custom main tree; completion remains partial.
